title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.8.3 is the verified repair release for the complete 43-notebook, 26-lecture CFD-to-scientific-machine-learning course. It restores end-to-end execution of the Week 15 geometry-generalization notebook, synchronizes six comparison figures with their SHA-256 provenance, removes duplicated figure footers, aligns citation and release metadata, and prevents evidence workflows from rewriting the main branch. The scientific results and frozen Week 15 evidence archives are unchanged; no new CFD or model training is claimed.
